title: Add a Content-Security-Policy to the window
notes: No CSP; model output is rendered as innerHTML with escaping as the only defence. Add a meta CSP (default-src self, img-src self data blob). Cost small. (docs/review/2026-11-01.md S2)

comments.body: Correction from the review's PR loop: the CSP also needs connect-src 'self' data: and frame-src blob:, which the PDF viewer uses. Without them a PDF tile opens blank.

Shipped in #181: meta CSP in index.html (default-src 'self', script-src 'self', inline styles, data: images and fonts, connect-src data: and frame-src blob: for the PDF viewer, object-src/base-uri/form-action 'none'), docs/app/README.md section, index.html.test.ts guard. Checked in a demo instance: terminals, chat image, PDF tile, doc viewer image, market cards, zero violations. Not checked: npm start dev server.
